card.name: Inside place and organization names
card.fires_on: The word that continues a proper name of a place or institution, right before a noun like Division, Band, School, Orchestra or Museum. It also fires on the digit in the drug name AMONDYS 45.

modes.label: Place name in an organization
modes.description: A place name continues into the next word of an organization's name, such as a band, school, museum or division.

card.writes: It seems to push toward more place-name or institution-name words, and away from words like lab, plaza and suite.
card.plain: It lights up in the middle of a place or organization name, where more name words are expected to follow.
